name: Mingi Jeong
title: Assistant Professor
department: Aerospace and Ocean Engineering; courtesy Computer Science
fitReason: Recent Assistant Professor with substantive learned intention inference driving a real marine robot during his Dartmouth PhD. New-host hardware and external visitor availability remain unverified.

physicalEvidence.status: Prior Dartmouth physical ASV with virtual obstacle traffic; physical 20
physicalEvidence.summary: A November 2024 study connects an LSTM passing-intention classifier to optimization-based navigation on the real Catabot ASV in Barbados. The boat encounters virtual surrounding traffic for safety, rather than actual autonomous vessels. Reported location B results cover three loops and four virtual obstacles under real wind. Inference is part of the action selection; the paper does not establish a new Virginia Tech platform. RENEW (January 2026) uses ocean-current data and simulation, not new robot execution.

shortVisit.summary: Official VT professional history gives December 2025 tenure-track start, resolving the later spring-2026 welcome announcement. The live author homepage advertises PhD openings, but no external-master visitor invitation or refusal was found.
